member.name: TextCodeActionMargin.Class
member.summary: Renders the code-action indicator (a light-bulb icon) for the visible indicator line and opens the actions menu when the left mouse button is pressed on that line.

remarks.para: The margin is driven by its : the controller reports the indicator's line and raises a change notification when the available actions change, so a connected margin invalidates itself without further host calls.

A left-button press on the indicator's line opens the actions menu anchored at the click; a press on a row without the indicator does nothing. The margin reserves the base class's standard width and the icon scales with the margin's font size, so the margin width stays proportional to the text when the editor font changes.

The icon's brush and geometry are replaceable through the inherited properties (the defaults are a theme-neutral gray and the library's light-bulb icon), and hosts are expected to set the brush to their theme's hint or accent color. The left-press gesture is the library default and can be turned off with ; a host that owns the gesture opens the same menu through with its own anchor.

member.name: OpenOnLeftPress
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a left-button press on the indicator's line opens the actions menu. Defaults to .
member.remarks: Set this to when the host owns the open gesture. The margin then leaves the press untouched, and the host opens the same menu through with its own anchor.
